title: Taking a taxi to a museum
objectives: Name the destination and ask how far it is
Ask the driver to slow down and give a reason

courseTemplate.setting: The Grand Museum is about twenty minutes away. The bridge is open and the tunnel is congested.

targetPatterns.pattern: The Grand Museum, please. Is it far from here?
targetPatterns.example: The Grand Museum, please. Is it far from here?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could we go via the bridge, please?
targetPatterns.example: Could we go via the bridge, please?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you slow down a bit? I'm feeling carsick.
targetPatterns.example: Could you slow down a bit? I'm feeling carsick.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you take me to this address, please?
targetPatterns.example: Could you take me to this address, please?

targetPatterns.pattern: About how much will it cost?
targetPatterns.example: About how much will it cost?

targetPatterns.pattern: Which line goes to Central Station?
targetPatterns.example: Which line goes to Central Station?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you drop me off at the corner?
targetPatterns.example: Could you drop me off at the corner?

targetPatterns.pattern: How long does it take to get downtown?
targetPatterns.example: How long does it take to get downtown?

stages.title: Name the destination and ask how far it is
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hello! Where are you heading?”
successCriteria: The learner can name the destination and ask how far it is in their own words.
hints: You can start with “The Grand Museum, please. …”

stages.title: Request a different route politely
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “It usually takes twenty minutes. We can take the tunnel or the bridge.”
successCriteria: The learner can request a different route politely in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could we go via …”

stages.title: Ask the driver to slow down and give a reason
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Sure, the bridge is clear. Is everything okay in the back?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask the driver to slow down and give a reason in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could you slow down …”

languageNotes: 「我在车上」不要说 "I'm on the car"（那是趴在车顶），轿车里用 in the car；公交/火车/地铁才用 on。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 请送我去这个地址。
warmup.suggestedAnswer: Could you take me to this address, please?

modelDialogue.text: The Grand Museum, please. Is it far from here?
It usually takes twenty minutes. We can take the tunnel or the bridge.
Could we go via the bridge, please?
Sure, the bridge is clear. Is everything okay in the back?
Could you slow down a bit? I'm feeling carsick.
